notes.title: 1945–1990 | Central Europe | the inner German border
sources: The Ländereinführungsgesetz of 22 July 1990 and the Unification Treaty (Einigungsvertrag, 31 August 1990, Article 1) re-established the five eastern states as the territory of the GDR, so their outer boundary is the inner German border; summarised at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_states_of_Germany.
Natural Earth’s 10m admin-1 states and provinces, for the boundary’s course.
The one later change: Amt Neuhaus, east of the Elbe, was in Mecklenburg and the GDR from 1945 and went to Lower Saxony on 30 June 1993 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amt_Neuhaus).
